type.provenance: prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

date.provenance: After December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-six

who.provenance: No person shall sell or offer for sale in this state anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

action.provenance: No person shall sell or offer for sale

value: anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
products.provenance: anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

value: products that have a certificate of compliance from the manufacturer
exceptions.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes shall be held in violation of this section if they can show that they relied in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer
